subject: general
question: In which of the following states is the Behdienkhlam festival celebrated in the month of July?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Meghalaya**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Behdienkhlam festival** is celebrated in the state of **Meghalaya** in the month of July.
 
• This festival is one of the most important and colorful festivals of the Jaintia tribe in Meghalaya.
 
• The term 'Behdienkhlam' literally means 'driving away the plague' and it is celebrated to drive away plague and to invoke the blessings of the gods for a good harvest.
 
• During the festival, large tree trunks are brought from the forest and are immersed in a sacred pool called 'Wah-ei-lad'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Meghalaya** is known for its rich cultural heritage and diverse tribal communities.
 
• The state is also famous for its scenic beauty, with numerous waterfalls, caves, and lush green landscapes.
 
• The capital city of Meghalaya is **Shillong**, which is often referred to as the 'Scotland of the East' due to its picturesque landscapes.
 
• Apart from Behdienkhlam, other major festivals celebrated in Meghalaya include **Wangala, Nongkrem Dance, and Shad Suk Mynsiem.**
 
• Meghalaya became a full-fledged state on **21st January 1972**, after being carved out from Assam.
